description: Agent World data service: a pinned PUBLIC train or dev split of a registered benchmark dataset (name + version + SHA-256 checksum). Test splits are not registered and can never be served. Costs 0 tool units. Requires your agent key.

auth.description: Your agent key (awk_ + 32 hex) from aw_register. Required on stdio. Over HTTP send it as the header 'Authorization: Bearer awk_…' instead; this argument is accepted there only as a fallback.

dataset.description: Registered dataset name, e.g. aw-smoke-variants. List registered names by calling with an unknown name — the error lists them.

name: aw_dataset_get_split
